title: Karpas
description: Dip vegetable in salt water. The word Karpas (כרפס) rearranged spells Paschr (פסכר) = ס' פרך — 60 types of hard labor. It also contains פס as in Yosef (יוסף) and Pesach (פסח), which equals 148 (gematria). Rabbeinu revealed in Likutay Moharan that the tikun of Pesach is through money (ממון with the 4 letters = 140).

segments.he:
טוֹבְלִין כַּרְפַּס פָּחוֹת מִכְּזַיִת בְּמֵי מֶלַח, וּמְבָרְכִין:
בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, בּוֹרֵא פְּרִי הָאֲדָמָה.
